error-tracking.name: Exception capture
error-tracking.description: Coerces any thrown value (Error, DOMException, ErrorEvent, promise rejections, plain objects, strings) into PostHog's exception list, parses Chrome, Firefox and Safari stack traces, collapses repeated recursion cycles, attaches chunk ids, and keeps the exception steps buffer.

user-agent.name: Browser, OS and device detection
user-agent.summary: Reads $browser, $os and $device_type from the user agent
user-agent.description: Detects the browser and its version, the operating system and the device type from a user agent string, as posthog-js does for every event's properties.

autocapture-utils.name: Autocapture DOM utilities
autocapture-utils.summary: Decides what a click captures and how it is described
autocapture-utils.description: The helpers autocapture runs on every click: element chains, which elements and values are safe to capture, sensitive-input checks, class and text extraction.

feature-flags.name: Feature flag responses
feature-flags.summary: Normalizes /flags responses into flag values and payloads
feature-flags.description: Normalizes /flags responses, in the older and the current format, into flag values, details and payloads; reads a flag's value and variant; trims the properties of $feature_flag_called events.

metrics.name: Metrics client
metrics.summary: Aggregates counters, gauges and histograms into OTLP
metrics.description: The pre-aggregating metrics client: counts, gauges and histograms per series, a cardinality cap, beforeSend hooks, retry-after backoff and the OTLP payload it sends.

uuidv7.name: UUIDv7 ids
uuidv7.summary: Generates the event and session ids
uuidv7.description: Generates time-ordered UUIDv7 values, the ids posthog-js gives every event and session, and reads the timestamp back out of one.

gzip.name: Request compression
gzip.summary: Gzips request bodies before they are sent
gzip.description: Compresses request bodies with the browser's CompressionStream, and tells whether gzip is supported and whether a body or request is already gzipped.

error-tracking.build-properties: 29 inputs through the properties builder: real Chromium errors with causes, an AggregateError, a DOMException, error and rejection events, strings, objects
error-tracking.parse-stacks: 11 Chrome, Firefox and Safari stack strings through the parser
error-tracking.exception-steps: 150 exception steps into the 32 KB buffer

user-agent.corpus: OS, browser, device, device type and version for the 606 user agents in posthog-js’s tests
user-agent.traffic-mix: the same per-event sequence for 200 events from a modern browser mix

autocapture-utils.click-pipeline: 43 clicks on a realistic app page through posthog-js’s autocapture flow, with the dead-click and rage-click checks
autocapture-utils.text-scrub: scrubbing page text, attributes and 12 network bodies

feature-flags.flags-v2-reads: a 64-flag /flags response handled as the client does: normalize, values, payloads, reads, overrides, the flag-called event
feature-flags.flags-v1-storage: rebuilding stored flags in the older format
